abstract_class_config.class_description: E2A base for SAP BOPF Settlement BO — saga orchestration, Redis idempotency, Kafka event publishing

generator.user_prompt: Generate a SettlementOrchestratorAgent that extends BaseSettlementAgent. It orchestrates a multi-step saga for financial settlement: idempotency check via Redis SETNX, saga step execution (LedgerDebit, LedgerCredit, Notification), state machine transitions (INITIATED -> LEDGER_PENDING -> COMPLETED), compensation on failure, and Kafka event publishing for each state change. Map to SAP BOPF Settlement BO pattern.
generator.system_prompt_additions: NFR: SagaCompensationMustBeIdempotent, RedisIdempotencyKeyTTL24h, KafkaProducerAcksAll, DoubleSpendProtectionViaAtomicSETNX, SettlementStateMachineGuardrails
